PowerShell($br = @\('kovex.com.br','kovex.br','kovextecnologia.com.br','kovextec.com.br','kovex.tec.br','kovex.app.br','kovex.dev.br'\); foreach \($d in $br\) { try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod "https://registro.br/v2/ajax/avail/raw/$d" -TimeoutSec 15; Write-Output \("{0} => status {1} \({2}\)" -f $d, $r.status, $r.reasons -join ','\) } catch { Write-Output \("{0} => erro: {1}" -f $d, $_.Exception.Message\) } })

PowerShell($doms = @\('kovex.com','kovex.tech','kovex.io','kovex.dev','kovex.app','kovex.co','kovex.net','kovex.digital','kovex.cloud','kovex.ai','usekovex.com','getkovex.com','kovexhq.com'\); foreach \($d in $doms\) { try { $ns = Resolve-DnsName $d -Type NS -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.Type -eq 'NS' }; if \($ns\) { Write-Output "$d => REGISTRADO \(tem NS\)" } else { Write-Output "$d => sem NS \(possivelmente livre\)" } } catch { if \($_.Exception.Message -match 'DNS name does not exist|Non-Existent'\) { Write-Output "$d => NXDOMAIN \(provavelmente LIVRE\)" } else { Write-Output "$d => inconclusivo: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } } })
